meta.title: AgentBridge — Git Commit & Push Workflow
meta.subtitle: Safe Staging, Review, Commit, and Permission-Gated Push Flow
meta.description: Step-by-step workflow for mobile operators navigating from review of working-tree status through interactive staging, diff inspection, commit creation, and permission-authorized remote push.

states.label: Review Git Status
states.description: Operator inspects working tree changes via structured porcelain v1 report on Telegram.

states.label: Select Files to Stage
states.description: Interactive mobile staging toggling individual modified or untracked candidate files.

states.label: Review Bounded Diff
states.description: Operator inspects secret-redacted, line-bounded staged diff before confirming mutations.

states.label: Staging Permission Check
states.description: PermissionEngine validates MEDIUM risk level and verifies no active workspace write lock conflict.

states.label: Stage Selected Files
states.description: Local Git executes git add -- [files] with path traversal containment validation.

states.label: Enter Commit Message
states.description: Operator provides commit message via /commit text command or quick commit button.

states.label: Commit Permission Check
states.description: PermissionEngine assesses HIGH risk level; verifies non-empty staged changes before execution.

states.label: Execute Commit
states.description: Local Git creates commit and records resulting SHA hash.

states.label: Push Preview & Verification
states.description: Calculates commits ahead, remote branch, and checks for merge conflicts or detached HEAD.

states.label: Push Permission Authorization
states.description: Explicit human authorization required for HIGH risk remote repository update. Force-push strictly rejected.

states.label: Push to Remote Repository
states.description: Git pushes commits to upstream remote (e.g. GitHub) safely.
